topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: So, they're converting our building to condos. Figures. Just when I thought everything was stable. Now, I’ve got to decide if I want to fork over what feels like an insane amount of money to buy my own place here, or start the whole apartment hunt again. Moving, packing, the endless search for that next temporary home—I thought I had settled this. Maybe I should be excited, a chance for a change, they say. But all I can think about is the stack of paperwork, the potential for neighbors who see me as just another face who hasn’t paid their dues. Lovely.
